fields.acceptance: A testscript runs a workflow setting FOO={run_tmp} and shows a command step sees it and the folder is gone after the run; a workflow without env sees no GOTMPDIR set by Rhiza.
fields.statement: A workflow file may set environment variables for every process its steps start, with {run_tmp} filled in as the run's own temp folder, which Rhiza creates when a step starts and removes when the run ends; Rhiza itself no longer sets GOTMPDIR (run-private-gotmpdir is replaced by this and retired).

fields.acceptance: rhiza workflow check passes on .rhiza/workflows and make self-check passes; a run of the cleanup command against a fake cache in a scratch dir removes only the stale entries.
fields.statement: Rhiza's own repo carries workflows in .rhiza/workflows that set GOTMPDIR to the run's temp folder and whose cleanup phase trims Go build cache entries unused for three hours, go-build temp folders older than two hours and rhiza test temp folders (rhiza-*) older than an hour.

fields.acceptance: The daemon-settings testscript lists no trimGoCache; internal/api daemon tests show no Go cache sweep; the generated reference is regenerated.
fields.statement: The daemon no longer trims the Go build cache: rhiza.daemon.trimGoCache is removed from daemon settings and the reference, and the daemon no longer calls gosweep (daemon-trims-go-cache and go-build-cache-sweep are retired).

fields.acceptance: internal/api ship tests show a repo whose ship-change names a head build renders with it and one that names none renders in-process, with isRhizaRepo gone from ship; Rhiza's workflows pass rhiza workflow check.
fields.statement: Ship no longer checks whether the repo is Rhiza's own: Rhiza's own ship-change workflow builds rhiza from the PR head in a step and ship's render and land use the binary that step names, while every other repo renders and lands in-process.
